split: Within each file, time-ordered segments; last 20% = test (same boundary as v1.0); rest = development
development_cv: 5 contiguous segment blocks per file, purge 1 neighbouring segment(s) on each side
features: 11 offset-invariant causal features (centered); level features excluded by design (label = file = date)
judged_rows: n_history >= 3; warm-up rows never predict, vote or alarm and count as no-alarm
training_rows: judged rows only; class_weight=balanced for supervised candidates
calibration: Platt scaling fitted on development OOF raw scores of judged rows

thresholds.unmanned: Development OOF: max F1 subject to FPR <= 0.1% (precision-first, unattended hours)
thresholds.standard: Development OOF: max F1 subject to FPR <= 1% (default)
thresholds.screening: Development OOF: highest threshold keeping judged-row recall >= 95% (inspection candidate list)

selection_rule: Eligible candidate with the highest development OOF row F1 at its own standard threshold (FPR <= 1%); ties -> higher OOF AP -> fewer FP -> simpler candidate
